title: Strict README Coverage Audit
summary: 65 README models | 19 README benchmark families | 5,768 exact numeric rows | 61 archived sources | 135 species mappings verified from primary sources

metrics.guardrail: Coverage means that at least one exact quantitative row was verified for the README entity. It does not mean that every model was evaluated on every benchmark. Rank models only after filtering to the same benchmark family, raw benchmark, task, species, metric, scale, protocol and split.
